name: Shameka Andre
office: Westside Union School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Shameka Andre is a school administrator and co-principal at Monte Vista Elementary School in the Lancaster School District. She previously taught second grade at Quartz Hill Elementary and served as a vice principal in the Westside Union School District focused on IEP support. Her doctoral research examined applying a systems approach to literacy in PK-12 education.
